tickets.title: P3-34: copier preflight -- verify followers before live arming
tickets.defect: The copier only has a per-relationship ArmedForLive bool with a name-based sim check (P1-20). The guard has RunPreflight + MinShadowSessions which is the best-designed safety feature in either addon. P3-34 wants the copier to have a preflight that verifies every follower is connected, subscribed, not locked, and has a resolvable instrument, before any relationship can be armed for live.
tickets.spec:
Add a RunCopierPreflight method to TradeCopierEngine that checks:
1. Every enabled relationship's follower account exists in Account.All.
2. Every enabled relationship's follower account is connected (provider != Disconnected).
3. Every enabled relationship's follower is not locked out (via RiskGuardAddOn.Instance.CanTrade).
4. If ArmedForLive is requested, verify the follower is NOT a simulated account (the existing P1-20 name-based sim check, but centralized in preflight).

The preflight returns a result object with Passed, FailureCode, FailureMessage -- same shape as the guard's PreflightResult.

This is the MINIMAL version -- a preflight check, not a full shadow mode. The full shadow mode (logging intended orders without submitting) is a larger feature and can follow.

CONSTRAINTS:
- The preflight must not hold _lock across Account.All enumeration.
- The preflight must be callable from the bridge (so the operator can check before arming).
- The preflight must report ALL failures, not just the first (so the operator sees every problem at once).
- If RiskGuardAddOn.Instance is null (guard not loaded), skip the CanTrade check rather than fail.
- The preflight does NOT block arming -- it reports. The caller decides whether to arm. This matches the guard's pattern (RunPreflight reports, ToggleArmed gates on it).
tickets.context: TradeCopierEngine has _relationships (List<CopierRelationship>) and _groups (List<CopierGroup>). CopierRelationship has LeaderAccountName, FollowerAccountName, IsEnabled, ArmedForLive. The guard's PreflightResult is at RiskGuardAddOn.cs ~3604. Account.All is the NT8 account list. RiskGuardAddOn.Instance.CanTrade checks lockouts.
